targets.old_statement: Before entering an intersection, yield to pedestrians and traffic already in it, look each way more than once, and check mirrors and over your shoulder for cyclists, motorcyclists or walkers entering your path.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Before entering an intersection, yield to pedestrians and traffic already in it, look each way more than once, and check mirrors and over your shoulder for cyclists, motorcyclists or walkers entering your path.
targets.statement: Before entering an intersection, stop and yield to pedestrians and traffic in it, look each way multiple times, and check side mirrors and over your shoulder for any cyclist, motorcyclist, or pedestrian entering your path.
